description: Source code for a mail splitting utility that processes mbox files and Maildir directories, splitting emails into individual files based on specific formats and options.

methods.name: is_from_line
methods.description: Checks if a line matches the 'From ' format with a date, indicating start of an email message.

methods.name: is_gtfrom
methods.description: Checks if a buffer starts with '>From ' indicating a Gmail-style 'From ' line.

methods.name: split_one
methods.description: Splits a single email message from an mbox file into a separate file.

methods.name: populate_maildir_list
methods.description: Populates a list with filenames from 'cur' and 'new' subdirectories of a Maildir.

methods.name: maildir_filename_cmp
methods.description: Comparator for Maildir filenames, sorting numerically when possible.

methods.name: split_maildir
methods.description: Splits emails from a Maildir directory into individual files.

methods.name: split_mbox
methods.description: Splits a mbox file into individual email files.

methods.name: cmd_mailsplit
methods.description: Main command function to process arguments and split mail files or directories.
